_comment: Copy to <project root>/jury-v2.json. No secrets here: the DeepSeek key stays in .env.local (DEEPSEEK_API_KEY). Prices are conservative CNY per million tokens; re-check official prices before paid runs.

judges.name: deepseek-pro
judges._role: Primary judge (option 3: single judge + DSPy + dev-fitted threshold).

judges.name: deepseek-flash
judges._role: Dev ablation control only. Same model family as Pro, so a Pro+Flash jury is NOT a heterogeneous jury.

_optional_later.name: qwen-local
_optional_later._note: Move into 'judges' only if a local Ollama model is available; free, a different model family.
